World of Watches

Police Watches

MARSDEN GOLD & BLACK WATCH

Striking gold dial accents are offset against a black background dial with the Marsden big dial watch from Police. A genuine black leather strap is easily adjustable for a comfortable wrist fit and other features include two time zones, both digital and analog time, and a light function.

NEIST ALL BLACK EAGLE WATCH

Confidence, dominance and fearlessness embody the Police Neist Eagle watch, perfectly matching the characteristics of the namesake apex bird of prey. Stepping away from conventional design, Neist boasts a black and grey geometric pattern dial with a rose gold eagle motif highlight

BUSHMASTER BROWN LEATHER WATCH

Make a big statement with the Bushmaster watch from Police. A large dial is surrounded by an antique treatment case to create a retro classic look. 50 metres water resistance and genuine leather strap. Also available in blue and grey contrasting colour designs.
